title: Enabling `ruff` C416
description:
# Summary

I decided to decompose my PR on incorporating `itertools.chain` a bit, and some of it can be automated by [C416](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/unnecessary-comprehension/). So this PR enables [C416](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/rules/unnecessary-comprehension/) in `ruff` to simplify code.

# Checklist

- [x] I understand that this PR may be closed in case there was no previous discussion. (This doesn't apply to typos!)
- [ ] I've added a test for each change that was introduced, and I tried as much as possible to make a single atomic change.
- [ ] I've updated the documentation accordingly.
